spots.name: UTD Mural
spots.blurb: You've reached UTD Mural, a mural. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: Patio Mural
spots.blurb: You've reached Patio Mural, a mural. An array of UT Dallas trademarks, including the love jack, chess players, the Natural Science and Engineering Research Laboratory building, and a comet, all painted amid the Dallas skyline.
